div.div:
1. What is SSI? What is the main difference between it and ABZ?
2. What is the output of our ADC?
3. How many shunt resistors for the phases? How do we choose a resistance value? FOC? Low side current sensing? ISSUE: For SimpleFOC, we need to know all 3 current phases, TMC6300 is weird as it bridges current for U and V, not allowing us to separate them. Soln: Inline current sensing instead?
4. Is there enough current budget? Is there enough torque output? What would be the ADC range?
5. Can we justly run the motor at 9V? What can we do to step the voltage down?
Grounding in current sense amplifiers
https://www.ti.com/lit/an/sboa536/sboa536.pdf?ts=1662480209644&ref_url=https%253A%252F%252Fwww.ti.com%252Fproduct%252FINA240
Filter ADC inputs w/ low pass
https://www.analog.com/en/resources/analog-dialogue/articles/practical-filter-design-precision-adcs.html
- To prevent aliasing: filter out frequencies >= sample frequency / 2
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5SMsRApsrQQ
